narr: The combination of abundant moisture and strong thunderstorms produced some flash flooding across portions of Kimble County.
ev: An emergency manager reported Ranch Road 385 and Farm to Market Road 3480 was closed due to water over the road from Red Creek.

There was flash flooding around Junction. There were road closures to County Road 450, Ranch Road 2189, County Road 410, County Road 320, County Road, Ranch Road 385 and areas along US 377. Also, there was 4 to 7 inches of rain during the past 18 hours.
lsr: RR 385 and FM 3480 Closed due to water from Red Creek over the road.
